subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: A miser got some money (a) ⎯⎯ he was not pleased with it. He was in constant fear (b) ⎯⎯ thieves and robbers would steal it. (c) ⎯⎯ he thought it necessary to devise some steps (d) ⎯⎯ no one might get scent of it and steal it. (e) ⎯⎯ much thought, he bought a lump of gold with all his money and buried it at a secret place.
guide_solution: (a) but (b) that (c) So (d) so that (e) After
